split: device-level; one CE model per seed with five post-hoc scorers and three Objectosphere arms; thresholds from known val-calib frames; unknown test frames (64QAM, 4PAM) influence no fit, selection or threshold

rate_definitions.unknown_score: larger = more unknown-like, for every scorer
rate_definitions.per_unknown_class.auroc: positive class = that unknown class; negatives = all known test frames
rate_definitions.per_unknown_class.reject_rate: positive = rejected (score > threshold); denominator = that class's n
rate_definitions.per_snr_auroc_and_bands: positive class = unknown; BOTH sides conditioned on the SNR value or band
rate_definitions.oscr.ccr: positive = accepted AND correct; denominator = all known test frames
rate_definitions.oscr.fpr: positive = unknown frame accepted (score <= t); denominator = all unknown test frames
